target: forge.sh pr-create (github) — looks up first, then gh pr create with the same head, base, title and body file; prints the URL gh reports
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote git@github.com:o/r.git
fx_gh pr_list 0 ''
fx_gh pr_create 0 'https://github.com/o/r/pull/8'
fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title "My title" --body-file body.md; fx_show r
echo "creates=$(fx_count gh pr create)"; echo "lists=$(fx_count gh pr list)"
fx_calls_text
fx_done
